notes: A saved bill now shows as it will print, in five formats (Classic, Modern, Tally, Compact half page, 80 mm roll), and can be shared as a PDF. Printing is fixed on A4 and on the roll: long names wrap, amounts line up, and a long bill goes on to more pages. Add your logo and signature in the business profile and they are printed on every bill; the profile also makes a shop card in five designs that you can share. New Expenses screen: rent, salary and other costs come out of the profit and out of the cash and bank balance. Stock can be shown as cards. Customers and Suppliers are separate screens. A shop chooses retail, wholesale or both. History filters by time, kind and payment together and shows the collection. The item picker warns of low stock. Home says Cash + Bank Balance, To Collect and To Pay.
